server.already_exists.description: API error when creating a resource whose name is already taken.

server.auth.invalid_credentials.description: Login error. It is generic on purpose, so it never reveals whether an account exists.

server.bad_request.description: API error for a malformed request that does not fit a more specific message.

server.cluster_forbidden.description: API error when the ?cluster= query value names a cluster the caller may not use or that is unknown.

server.conflict_retry.description: API error when a concurrent write changed the resource; the caller should re-read and retry.

server.empty_body.description: API error when a route that expects a JSON body receives none.

server.forbidden.description: API error when the Kubernetes API denies the operation for the API's service identity.

server.generic.400.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 400 response.

server.generic.401.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 401 response.

server.generic.403.defaultMessage: You do not have permission to do this.
server.generic.403.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 403 response.

server.generic.404.defaultMessage: The requested item was not found.
server.generic.404.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 404 response.

server.generic.409.defaultMessage: The request conflicts with the current state.
server.generic.409.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 409 response.

server.generic.413.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 413 response.

server.generic.422.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 422 response.

server.generic.429.defaultMessage: Too many requests. Please wait and try again.
server.generic.429.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 429 response.

server.generic.500.defaultMessage: The server hit an internal error.
server.generic.500.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 500 response.

server.generic.501.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 501 response.

server.generic.502.defaultMessage: An upstream service returned an error.
server.generic.502.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 502 response.

server.generic.503.description: Generic sentence shown before the detail text for an HTTP 503 response.

server.internal.description: API error for an unexpected server failure. The real error is logged on the server only.

server.invalid.description: API validation error. The argument detail is the validation message from Kubernetes, in English, and describes the caller's input.

server.namespace_forbidden.description: API error when the user's role does not cover the requested namespace.

server.not_found.description: API error when the requested resource does not exist.

server.remote_cluster_not_implemented.defaultMessage: not implemented: no cross-cluster agent yet; this route only serves the home cluster
server.remote_cluster_not_implemented.description: API response for a home-cluster-only route called with a ?cluster= value that names another cluster. No cross-cluster agent exists yet.

server.unauthorized.description: API error when the Kubernetes API rejects the credentials used for the operation.
